$comment: Tile rendering styles measured from the Boda Games Shikoku 1889 punchboards (artassets/shikoku). Values are PDF points on a 108 pt flat-to-flat hex (vertex radius 62.35 pt); 'renderer' values are the same numbers scaled to the shared TileArtwork hex (vertex radius 50). Ink is #231f20 everywhere.

plain.description: Flat saturated tile colours, white track casing, white station circles with an ink ring, white revenue ovals. Printed on the seating-order side of each punchboard.

patterned.description: Muted tile colours over a tone-on-tone ornamental hex lattice, no white casing (track is cased in the tile colour to cut the pattern), station circles filled in a darker tint of the tile colour, white revenue ovals.
